name: Live Face Swap MCP
summary: Hosted Streamable HTTP MCP for quoted, approval-gated MP4 face-swap jobs paid with Live Face Swap credits. OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; unauthenticated calls get 401.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Live Face Swap at live-face-swap.net). Public MCP docs at https://live-face-swap.net/mcp (HTTP 200; last updated Nov 20, 2026) describe a remote Streamable HTTP server at https://live-face-swap.net/api/mcp. Official wording: connect a remote MCP client, get a quote for a video face swap, approve a job using existing site credits, and open a private page to download the finished MP4. Quotes and preparation do not consume credits; the site reserves credits when a confirmed job starts. The client must support OAuth with PKCE and dynamic client registration; when the client opens a browser, the operator signs in and reviews and approves the connection. Terms of Service (updated 2026-11-12) and the Acceptable Use Policy at https://live-face-swap.net/acceptable-use-policy (updated 2026-11-16; HTTP 200) apply. You must be at least 18 and legally able to enter into an agreement; the AUP says the service is intended for adults aged 18 or above. Under the Terms heading "Images, consent, and synthetic media": rights in a photograph and permission to use the depicted person's likeness are separate — you need both where required for the intended use; a public profile photo, celebrity image, or downloadable portrait is not automatically authorized; do not use the service for deception, impersonation fraud, non-consensual intimate imagery, harassment, exploitation, or bypassing identity and liveness checks; if realistic AI alterations could cause viewers to mistake content for an authentic person or event, clearly disclose the alteration and comply with applicable platform rules. Pricing (https://live-face-swap.net/pricing, HTTP 200): camera preview, recording, replay and downloads add no AI charge; paid generation uses credits. LFS Prism Standard is 0.5 credits per connected second, Pro is 1; confirmed charges round up to whole credits per session. Monthly plans and one-time packs are listed; monthly subscriptions renew automatically until future renewals are canceled in billing. Terms: cancellation and refunds are separate; for duplicate payments, missing credits or incorrect usage charges contact support@live-face-swap.net; successfully used generation is not reversed because a recording was not saved; mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected. No official public GitHub LICENSE was used for this hosted product; the service is proprietary under the site terms. Queue #47 claims were checked against the MCP docs, llms.txt, pricing, terms, the Acceptable Use Policy, the OAuth protected-resource document, and read-only probes. No signup, OAuth, credit purchase, or tool call.

agent_access.notes: Bare GET of https://live-face-swap.net/api/mcp (and GET with Accept application/json or text/event-stream) returned HTTP 405 with Allow: POST and an empty body. Unauthenticated initialize and tools/list POSTs returned HTTP 401 application/json JSON-RPC error {"code":-32000,"message":"invalid_token"} with WWW-Authenticate Bearer error="invalid_token", resource_metadata="https://live-face-swap.net/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/api/mcp", scope="video_swap". That well-known document (HTTP 200) lists resource https://live-face-swap.net/api/mcp, authorization_servers https://live-face-swap.net/api/auth, and scopes_supported video_swap. Tools were not called; no OAuth, signup, or spend. Official docs say a job starts only after the operator approves a quote on the website.
